jobs.title: Product Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
About Peec AI 
 Peec AI is the visibility platform for the age of AI search. The way people discover brands is being rewritten. ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Mode and Copilot now sit between companies and their customers, and most brands have no idea what those models say about them. We built the platform marketing teams use to measure, understand and improve how they show up inside AI answers.
 We went from 0 to $10M ARR in 16 months. We're around 80 people, based in Berlin with a growing presence in New York, and we're moving fast enough that the people joining now are writing the playbook everyone after them will run.
 Measuring the problem is only the first half. The second half is software that acts: agents that watch what a brand is doing across AI search, surface what matters, and then do the work. We're building that agent layer from the ground up, and this PM will define and own it.
 
 What You'll Do
 Own the agentic product surface at Peec AI, from the harness itself to the experience built around it

 Build agents that act proactively on customer data, alongside a pod of data scientists, AI engineers and a frontend engineer

 Work directly with our largest agency and brand customers, building specific agents for a handful of them first and scale it further to other users

 Turn what works for those first customers into product everyone can use

 Hold a high bar on interface quality

  
 Who You Are
 You have built an agent harness or a proactive agentic system, something that looks at a user's data or the work in front of them and then does the work rather than just suggesting it

 Your agent experience is in a B2B or prosumer context

 3+ building excellent software products, ideally at a startup or fast-moving company

 Real working experience alongside data scientists and AI engineers. You do not need to have been one, but you need to speak the language

 Strong customer-facing instincts. You are comfortable in the room with a large customer, scoping what they actually need

 High design and UI standards

 You operate with very little direction and are happy owning an entire surface on your own

 Excited to be in our Berlin office five days a week

 On the agent requirement: a job, a serious side project, a university project or a hackathon build all count, as long as it shipped and you can walk us through it. Beyond that we care far more about what you have built than how long you have been building.
  
 Bonus Points
 An engineering background, or code you have written that is running in production

 Previous founder experience

 Previous experience building AI-driven or search-related products

 What We Offer 
 Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

 Regular team events and off-sites

 Aggressive equity compensation package

 Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late

 The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

 Compensation: €100K – €130K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.
 Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.
 We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .
 
 About the Role 
 
 As a Project Manager at Sona, you'll lead the coordination of an Implementation Pod consisting of a Solutions Architect and a Solutions Specialist, and together you'll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations for our customers.
 
 You'll run implementations of Sona's products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You'll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We're a growing business, so you'll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

 Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

 Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships and managing expectations throughout delivery.

 Coordinate internal teams, vendors and customers to ensure successful outcomes and efficient resource deployment.

 Produce clear, consistent documentation and status reports, escalating risks where required.

 Support our Land and Expand approach by driving strong customer partnerships and early value realisation.

 Continuously improve project processes and tools to enhance delivery speed, quality and customer satisfaction.

 
 Requirements 
 
 Proven success delivering enterprise software implementation projects on time, within budget and scope.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

 Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to influence without direct authority.

 Strategic thinker with strong risk management, planning and prioritisation capabilities.

 Calm, organised and results-driven under pressure, with excellent time management.

 Confident in presenting, reporting and managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

 Bonus: experience with workforce management or HR software, experience managing customers in a frontline or operationally complex industry.

 
 Benefits 
 
 Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 per annum

 Hybrid working pattern (2+ days per week in our London office, plus customer travel across the UK)

 Share options

 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

 Extra day of leave for every year of service

 Pension contributions matched up to 5%

 Comprehensive health insurance

 Enhanced parental leave & pay

 Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

 Annual all expenses paid team retreats

 The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

 Professional development budget

 Unlimited free books

 Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben Du übersetzt Strategie in Features: Du identifizierst Nutzerprobleme, bewertest Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends und entwickelst aus groben Zielen und Produktvisionen konkrete Features – mit einem Gespür dafür, was besonders mobile Produkte auszeichnet. 

 Du schreibst Anforderungen, die tragen: Du bereitest Themen so auf, dass Designer und Entwickler direkt loslegen können – nicht erst nachfragen müssen. 

 Du denkst User Journeys, nicht nur User Stories: Du skizzierst Konzepte, verwirfst Ideen, entwickelst sie weiter – und findest den besten Weg für unsere Nutzer:innen. 

 Du coachst und befähigst: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Managern zusammen, gibst fachliches Feedback und hilfst ihnen, in ihrer Rolle zu wachsen. 

 Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle: Im engen Austausch mit Projektleitung, UX, Entwicklung, Sales und weiteren Stakeholdern sorgst du dafür, dass aus Ideen echte Features werden – termingerecht und in hoher Qualität. 

 Du machst Erfolg messbar: Gemeinsam mit den Teams definierst du Erfolgskennzahlen, leitest daraus Prioritäten ab und misst den Erfolg neuer Produktinitiativen. 

 

 Dein Profil Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement – idealerweise mit digitalen Produkten, die eine hohe Komplexität und Reichweite haben, und bringst Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte mit. 

 Du hast Strategie in Features übersetzt – nicht nur verwaltet, sondern aktiv gestaltet. Du kannst zeigen, welche Produkte du konzeptionell vorangebracht und von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleitet hast. 

 Du verstehst, was mobile Produkte anders macht als Web – du musst kein App-Store-Experte sein, aber du kennst die Unterschiede in UX, Architektur und Nutzerverhalten. 

 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Produktstrategie, Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation mit und kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen übersetzen. 

 Du bringst eine ausgeprägte  KI-Affinität  mit und nutzt KI-Tools souverän, um Produktideen zu schärfen, Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und datenbasierte Entscheidungen vorzubereiten. 

 Du schreibst Anforderungen mit Substanz – klar, vollständig, priorisiert. Deine User Stories sind keine Platzhalter, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage. 

 Du arbeitest  strukturiert und kreativ zugleich: Du hast Methoden für Ideenfindung und Konzeption – und die Disziplin, Ergebnisse festzuhalten. 

 Du kannst fachlich coachen , ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du gibst Feedback, das Kolleg:innen weiterbringt. 

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau). Außerdem kannst du sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren. 

 Du lässt dich vom fußballbegeisterten Spirit deiner Teammitglieder anstecken und bringst idealerweise selbst deine Leidenschaft für Fußball mit ein. 

 Da sich unser Büro in Hamburg befindet, ist die Stelle vorzugsweise an unserem Standort in Hamburg zu besetzen.  Gleichzeitig bieten wir die Möglichkeit, flexibel im hybriden Modell zu arbeiten. 

 Deine Vorteile bei uns Begeisterung für Fußball: Unser internationales Team teilt eine leidenschaftliche Liebe zum Fußball – du hast die Möglichkeit, dieses hautnah im Stadion zu erleben, indem du von VIP- und Dauerkarten profitierst. 

 Spielraum für Innovation: Entfalte neue Ideen und nutze Formate wie Brownbags und Reviews, um kontinuierlich unsere Weiterentwicklung voranzutreiben. 

 Flexibilität: Profitiere von mobiler Arbeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Workation-Möglichkeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. 

 Teamzusammenhalt: Regelmäßige "Get-Together" und Team-Events stärken unseren Teamgeist. Von unterhaltsamen Fußballquizzen bis hin zu anderen sportlichen Aktivitäten und unseren festlichen Weihnachtsfeiern. 

 Entwicklungschancen: Wir unterstützen deine Weiterbildung durch Seminare, Weiterbildungen und die Teilnahme an Konferenzen zur Vernetzung. Unsere wöchentlichen internen Englischkurse tragen nicht nur zur Verbesserung deiner Sprachkenntnisse bei, sondern stärken auch die Vernetzung innerhalb Transfermarkt. 

 Mobilität: Nutze die Möglichkeit, das Deutschlandticket vergünstigt zu erwerben, um flexibel und kostengünstig zu reisen. 

 Zukunftssicherung: Wir fördern deine finanzielle Absicherung mit Zuschüssen zur VWL und betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. 

 Wohlfühlatmosphäre im Büro: Wir stellen Getränke, Obst und Snacks für dich bereit. Zwischendurch hast du die Möglichkeit, bei einer Runde FIFA oder beim Kickern mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen abzuschalten.

Wer wir sind Die GBC Group GmbH ist eine inhabergeführte IT-Unternehmensgruppe mit über 500 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 10 Standorten in Deutschland. Nach dem Buy-and-Build-Prinzip vereinen wir 12 spezialisierte Tochtergesellschaften unter einem Dach, jede mit eigener Expertise und einer gemeinsamen Vision. Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.

 Dein Wirkungsfeld Wenn die GBC Group eine Gesellschaft übernimmt, beginnt die eigentliche Arbeit erst danach: Strukturen zusammenführen, Standards etablieren, Führung, Ergebnisse sichtbar machen. Genau hier setzt diese Rolle an. Du bist die Verbindung zwischen der strategischen Agenda der Gruppe und der operativen Realität in den Tochtergesellschaften und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Zielen tatsächlich Ergebnisse werden.

Du agierst dabei nicht als Berater, der Empfehlungen abgibt und wieder geht, sondern als jemand, der mit den Geschäftsführern vor Ort Umsetzungen schafft, Widerstände einkalkuliert und trotzdem liefert. Dein Beitrag entscheidet mit darüber, wie schnell und wie erfolgreich eine Integration gelingt.

 Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung Du übersetzt strategische Ziele der Gruppe in konkrete, messbare Projekte gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften vor Ort
 Du analysierst, definierst und planst Verbesserungsinitiativen aus,- etwa zur Steigerung der operativen Auslastung, zum Aufbau von Führungs- und Reportingstrukturen, zur Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung oder zur Einführung von IT-Systemen und trackst deren Umsetzung konsequent bis zum Abschluss
 Du gestaltest die projektbegleitende Kommunikation aktiv und steuerst Stakeholder proaktiv, statt auf Widerstände zu reagieren
 Du sparrst und coachst Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe - auch wenn das bedeutet, unbequeme Punkte anzusprechen
 Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der GBC Group Geschäftsführung PMI-Blueprints und Standards, die für künftige Integrationen wiederverwendbar sind
 Du reportest transparent an die GBC Group Führung und eskalierst Risiken frühzeitig
 

 Was Du mitbringst Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Zahlenaffinität
 Beratungshintergrund aus der Prozess-, Strategie- oder IT-Beratung
 Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit, Führungserfahrung
 Projektleitungserfahrung in komplexen Change- und Implementierungsprojekten 
 Erfahrung in Post-Merger-Integration-Projekten, Operational Excellence
 Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit klarem Fokus auf das Wesentliche
 Affinität zu Informationstechnologie, insbesondere zu KI-Systemen
 Reisebereitschaft sowie einen Führerschein Klasse B
 Kann-Kriterien
 Expertenwissen in M365, vor allem PowerPoint, Excel und Power BI
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar
 

 Was Dich bei uns erwartet Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und entsprechend wenig Kontrolle im Detail - wir erwarten, dass du Ergebnisse lieferst, nicht dass du Beschäftigung nachweist
 Deine Entwicklung bei uns hängt an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Titeln oder Betriebszugehörigkeit
 Reporting und Entscheidungswege sind kurz und direkt, auch zur Geschäftsführung
 Bis zu 20 % deiner Arbeitszeit kannst du remote gestalten, der überwiegende Teil findet dort statt, wo die Projekte laufen - bei den Tochtergesellschaften in Norddeutschland
 Leistungsorientierte Kultur: Entwicklung, Förderung und Wertschätzung erfolgen basierend auf tatsächlicher Leistung
 

 Unser Bewerbungsprozess Erstgespräch HR (ca. 30-45 Minuten)
 Fachliches Interview inkl. praxisnahem Use Case
 Persönliches Kennenlernen vor Ort
 Entscheidung & Angebot
 Referenzgespräche führen wir ausschließlich mit Deiner ausdrücklichen Zustimmung
 

 Hast Du Fragen? Bei Fragen oder Anliegen zu Bewerbungen oder zum Bewerbungsprozess kontaktiere gerne unser HR-Team per E-Mail unter  Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner – CRM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your Contribution As Senior Product Owner – CRM, you drive the evolution of our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms and ensure they continuously support our business objectives. You combine product ownership with a strong focus on business process excellence, challenging existing ways of working and identifying opportunities for simplification and automation. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you align stakeholders across functions and countries around a shared product vision. Through continuous improvement of customer, operational, and financial processes, you help create better customer experiences, higher efficiency, and scalable business operations.

 Menu of Responsibilities In this role, you take ownership of our CRM and ERP landscape and drive continuous improvement across business-critical processes: 
 Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms, aligned with business strategy and customer experience goals. 
 Analyse , challenge, and continuously improve end-to-end business processes across Order-to-Cash, billing, payments, customer management,  logistics , procurement, and finance. 
 Own and  prioritise  the product backlog, translating business needs and process improvement opportunities into clear user stories and deliverables. 
 Partner with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Support, Operations, Logistics, and Data teams to align priorities and  maximise  business value. 
 Lead collaboration with implementation and service partners, ensuring solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and expected outcomes. 
 Drive adoption of new capabilities by ensuring process integrity, data quality, effective release planning, stakeholder engagement, and continuous feedback. 
 

 Ingredients for Success Proven  experience  in  Product  Ownership,  Product  Management, Business Analysis,  or  a  similar   role   within  CRM, ERP,  or   business   systems   environments . 
 Strong  understanding  of  commercial , operational,  financial , and  logistics   processes ,  with  the  ability  to  identify  and  drive   process   improvements . 
 Experience  managing   product   backlogs ,  priorities , and  stakeholder   expectations   within  agile  ways  of  working . 
 Excellent  communication  and  facilitation   skills ,  enabling   alignment  and  decision-making   across  diverse  stakeholder   groups . 
 Customer- focused   mindset   combined   with  a  passion  for  continuous   improvement , operational excellence, and  measurable   business   outcomes . 
 Experience working with CRM and ERP platforms; knowledge of Odoo is beneficial. Fluent English is  required .

jobs.title: Product Manager, Business Technology
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Product Manager for Business Technology, you will own internal products that shape how Anthropic works with Claude. You will embed with internal customer teams such as Legal, IT, GTM, Product, Finance, and Security to understand how they work, find where Claude can remove friction, and ship software and automation that changes their outcomes. This role requires strong product judgment, comfort with technical systems, and the ability to turn messy internal needs into clear priorities.

You will work closely with engineering, IT, IT Engineering, Security, and the teams you serve. You will own outcomes, not features. Adoption and measured business impact are how your work is judged.

Core responsibilities

Internal product ownership

  • Own the roadmap for Claude-powered internal products and automation across one or more customer functions.
  • Run intake and prioritization so that the highest-impact problems get built first and the rest get a clear answer.
  • Write crisp problem statements and requirements that engineers can act on without rework.
  • Ship iteratively, gather feedback from the people using the product, and keep improving it after launch.

Adoption and business impact

  • Co-develop adoption roadmaps with internal customer teams and hold both sides to them.
  • Define success metrics before work starts and report adoption and business impact on a regular cadence.
  • Treat change management as part of the product. Plan rollout, training, and support so that what you ship gets used.
  • Kill or rework products that are not earning their keep.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with leaders in the functions you serve and translate their needs into product priorities.
  • Partner with IT, IT Engineering, and Security on access, data handling, and governance so that internal Claude usage follows internal policy.
  • Coordinate with Legal and Finance on the requirements that apply to your products.
  • Communicate plans, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to the teams and leaders you work with.

Technical leadership

  • Understand how Claude, internal systems, and integrations fit together well enough to make sound scoping and sequencing calls.
  • Partner with engineering on architecture choices that keep internal products maintainable and secure.
  • Stay current on Claude capabilities and bring new ones to internal teams where they fit.

Qualifications

Required

  • You have deep product management experience, including ownership of products used by internal teams.
  • You have shipped products that measurably changed how a team or function works.
  • You have partnered with engineering, IT, and security teams on technical products.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person. You can explain a tradeoff to an executive and a requirement to an engineer.
  • You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and setting priorities across competing requests.

Nice to have

  • You have built with LLMs or agent tooling.
  • You have worked on IT, internal tools, or business systems products.
  • You have led change management or rolled out new tools across an organization.
  • You know security and data-handling practices for internal systems.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

Developing impactful solutions is something we do together at Ensono because Ideas Start Here. Great things happen when many voices are heard, and people are supported to run with their ideas. On our teams, you will be backed by leaders with a passion for our business. This is a place where your ideas can Do Great Things.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business.

Adventure starts here. Here you will be a part of a team that encourages you to master your craft, ask tomorrow’s questions today, and chart your path. Our Associates focus on client impact with curiosity and a feeling of relentless commitment.

About the role and what you will be doing:

The Senior Project Manager provides senior-level expertise to plan, organise, control, and deliver large, complex infrastructure and data centre migration projects across Ensono's client portfolio. Operating within the Global Project and Implementation (GPI) practice, this role manages multiple company-wide initiatives simultaneously — from scope definition and budget planning through to delivery and post-implementation review. A key part of this position involves building and maintaining strong relationships with client sponsors and internal leaders, including regular on-site engagement at the client's London office. The Senior Project Manager interfaces directly with client executive management to understand critical business priorities and ensures every project is completed within agreed scope, quality, time, and cost constraints.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - New Bets
jobs.description:
Who is Heidi? 
 Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care.
 We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages.
 Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.
 Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others.
 We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge?
  
 The Role
 Heidi's core products are expanding in both scope and reach. Scribe already powers more than 3 million patient consultations a week, and Evidence and Remote are scaling behind it. We're now building out the New Bets function to create the next wave of new products.
 This is a zero-to-one product role inside a company that already has proven impact and partnerships with the NHS, which is the combination every early-stage PM wants and almost never gets. Most v1s launch into silence. Yours go in front of clinicians who already open Heidi every day, and who will tell you within a week whether you've built something they need. You can ship on a Tuesday, watch a GP use it on a Thursday, and know where you stand by Friday. In addition to the external feedback loop, within the London Office, we have Clinicians sat within Customer Success, Regulatory Compliance and GTM, so there is plenty of lived experience within reach.
 You'll own new bets end to end, not features on someone else's roadmap. You take a problem space from conviction to evidence: frame it, size the prize, prototype it, put it in front of real clinicians, and make the call. A few bets become Heidi's next product line. Most don't. Killing them cleanly, quickly and without ceremony is as much the craft as scaling the winners.
 A small dedicated squad sits alongside you to build and test. If it needs a pilot scoped with a health system, you scope it. If it needs a landing page, you write it.
 You might already be a PM. You might be a strategy consultant who is tired of recommending and wants to own what happens next. You might have run operations and spent the last two years fixing the product from the outside. The title matters less than the pattern: you build things, you move fast, and ambiguity makes you sharper, not slower.
  
 What you'll do
 Own each bet end to end: the problem it goes after, why it matters now, and the goals and success metrics you set and are held accountable to

 Take each bet from thesis to evidence - frame the problem, size the prize and define what "working" means before anything gets built

 Prototype fast, often yourself: a v0 built in Cursor or Claude Code beats a sprint of engineering time spent on the wrong thing

 Get out of the building: sit in clinics, watch how visits actually run and turn what you see into the next sprint

 Design pilots with commercial and regional teams that produce a decision. Think real accounts, real usage, honest numbers

 Make the scale-or-kill call and own the narrative with founders, leadership and customers

 Do whatever the bet needs: pricing, positioning, onboarding, the launch email. There's no one else to hand it to, which is the point

 Graduate the winners into staffed product lines with roadmaps someone else can run, then start again
  

 If we'd worked together the last 6 weeks, you'd have:
 Taken a bet from a one-page thesis to a working prototype in front of clinicians, and rewritten the thesis because of what they did with it

 Built the first version yourself in Claude Code over a weekend, because waiting for a sprint felt slower than learning

 Spent half-days with three customer accounts watching how the product fits (or doesn't) into a real clinical day, and come back with discrete tickets that changed the next sprint

 Killed a bet you liked, written the honest two-paragraph post-mortem and had the squad pointed at the next one by Monday

 Scoped a paid pilot with commercial for a product that didn't exist a month ago, with success metrics in place

 Walked the founders through a scale-or-kill recommendation and changed the roadmap with it
  

 What you'll need
 4+ years in product, strategy consulting, operations or within a founding team — we care more about what you've owned and shipped than the title on your CV

 Proof you build: a product with real users, an internal tool your old team still runs, a business, a prototype that got funded.

jobs.description:
Intro Rückenprobleme sind der häufigste Grund für Arbeitsunfähigkeit in Deutschland.

 Vivira hat die Lösung: Wir machen digitale Bewegungstherapie per App. Immer verfügbar, einfach, wirksam und von der Krankenkasse erstattet. Vivira wurde aus dem Bedürfnis geboren, Muskel-Skelett-Erkrankungen so unkompliziert und effektiv wie möglich zu therapieren.

 Deine Aufgaben umfassen Als Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/w/d) spielst Du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, unser bestehendes digitales Therapieangebot weiterzuentwickeln und auszubauen. Du treibst maßgeblich voran, wie wir Patient:innen und Ärzt:innen künftig noch besser bei der Behandlung und Reduktion muskuloskelettaler Schmerzen unterstützen können. 

Je nach Erfahrung und aktuellem Fokus übernimmst Du Verantwortung für einen zentralen Produkt- oder Wachstumsbereich entlang unserer Patient:innen-, Therapie- oder Praxis-Journey – als Schnittstelle zwischen medizinischer Relevanz, technischer Machbarkeit, regulatorischen Anforderungen und kommerziellem Erfolg. Dabei konzipierst, validierst und priorisierst Du neue Produkt- und Serviceideen und bereitest diese strukturiert für die Umsetzung vor. 

Deine Arbeit legt den Grundstein für den Ausbau unseres Produkt- und Serviceportfolios, stärkt langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und schafft nachhaltigen Mehrwert – auch über die eigentliche Therapiephase hinaus.

 Das solltest Du mitbringen Erfahrung:  Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Product Management (typischerweise 5+ Jahre), z. B. als Senior, Lead oder Principal Product Manager oder Product Owner, idealerweise im Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA oder ähnliche Bereiche. Du hast einen digitalen Produktbereich eigenständig verantwortet und kannst zeigen, wie Deine Entscheidungen Nutzer:innen- und Business-Outcomes verändert haben.
 Outcome-orientierte Produktentwicklung: Du steuerst nach Wirkung, nicht nach Output – datengetriebene Entscheidungen sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
 Stakeholder Management und Cross-functional Leadership:  Du kommunizierst sicher mit C-Level, Engineering, Regulatory und dem klinischen Team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Product Manager)
jobs.description:
About Lendable
 Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
 
 One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

 Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 Profitable since 2017

 Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )

 We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. 
 
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 Build the best technology in-house , using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 
 About the role 
 We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.
 This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.
 Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Own platform stability 
 Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

 Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

 Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

 Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

 Be commercially accountable 
 Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

 Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

 Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

 Own the platform roadmap 
 Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

 Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

 Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

 Be the stakeholder interface 
 Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

 Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

 Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

 Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

 Contribute as an engineer 
 Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

 Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

 
 What we're looking for 
 Essential 
 Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

 Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a lin

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀
 Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.
 
 At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.
 
 We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.
 
 The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters! 
 [ Read our Impact Report ] | [ See our Trustpilot ]
 
 The role ⚡ 
 📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits
 
 What we’re looking for 🌱 
 We firmly believe that data is core to our mission to build the place where small businesses can get the funding they need to win. It is our key asset and is fundamental to the growth of our company. As such, we’re looking to strengthen our Data Product team to help us continue to build a world class data ecosystem, working on cutting edge data concepts and technologies.
 
 This role will work closely with a team of data engineers & analytics engineers to build data products, supporting key stakeholders across the business - including risk, data scientists, commercial …and more!
 
 What you'll be doing
 Be a senior member of the data product team, reporting into the Lead Data Product manager, responsible for enabling Funding Circle to be data driven and to help grow our data maturity.

 Support and coach junior colleagues in data product management.

 Support Senior Data leaders with strategic development of Data Products at Funding Circle.

 Be a data champion, enabling the transformation of the way data is thought of and implemented at Funding Circle.

 Build a strong network of stakeholders within the business, understanding their objectives, translating them into a prioritised roadmap of work.

 Become an SME and take ownership of the OKRs and planning cycles of your domain.

 Work with engineers to help shape solutions that deliver value to our stakeholders - from making new data available to creating useful, structured datasets for analytics.

 Act as a translator between product engineering teams producing data and reporting and analytics teams using data to align roadmaps and requirements.

 Work with the wider teams to maximise the value realised from our data using cutting edge data technologies.

 
 Skills we’d love to see: 
 Proven experience of understanding stakeholder goals and turning them into successful products.

 Experience managing a wide group of stakeholders across all parts of the business, joining the dots to create solutions that work for everyone and prioritise work within the engineering team.

 Experience of working with data platforms (data warehouse / data lake) and understanding the core elements that make up these platforms.

 Experience of working with Data Scientists, Analysts and / or BI teams

 Proficiency in SQL for data exploration and analysis.

 Be the voice of the product, translating technical delivery into business outcomes and communicate this out eﬀectively.

 You like to get into the details and solving problems but can also step back and communicate the bigger picture.

 You build collaborative and constructive relationships.

 Understand what's possible with data and the impact it has on an organisation.

 We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you. 
 
 Why join us? 💜 
 We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026 ! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!
 Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:
 Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

 Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

 Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

 Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

 Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

 We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.
 
 Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

jobs.title: Application Product Manager - AI System Transformations
jobs.description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

The Celonis Business Apps IT is a team of product enthusiasts and data engineers that focuses on developing best-in class composable AI solutions in the domain of System Transformations (migrations such as SAP ECC to S/4, introduction of new software, system landscape consolidation, etc.). Business Apps are purpose-built solutions created for a specific line of business, addressing most impactful pain points in their respective domain. The solutions are best practice examples of how Celonis is used in new, innovative ways that push the boundaries of our platform. The team has a great balance of technical skills to build solutions paired with a customer focus and product management mindset to create meaningful products widely adopted across our customer base.

The Role

We're looking for a hybrid between a product manager and an engineer. Someone who can sit with a customer, understand a transformation pain point, and then go design and build the solution together with the rest of the team rather than handing it off. You'll operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where shipping quickly matters more than perfect process, and where the line between "designing the product" and "building the product" is intentionally blurry. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, composing AI-driven applications, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

You'll be at the frontier of how Celonis reimagines enterprise system transformation. Turning a bold vision into working products that customers adopt. If you're energized by owning something end-to-end, moving fast, and being measured by what you ship rather than what you spec, this is for you.

The work you'll do

Your mission is to make the vision of AI powered system transformation a reality. Building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis Process Intelligence platform from strategy into solutions customers run on.

  • Build and ship purpose-built but flexible solutions that span the full enterprise modernization journey
  • Leverage the most cutting-edge capabilities of the Celonis platform and compose them into coherent, deployable solutions
  • Work hands-on with frontier AI development tools that plug natively into the platform, using them to accelerate how you build, enrich, and deploy solutions

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software. 
 REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.
 We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.
 Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.
 
 The role
 This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.
 Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.
 You will own how we get there. 
 You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:
 Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning. 
 You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers , raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.
 You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.
 
 What you’ll do
 Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

 Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

 Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

 Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

 Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

 Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

 Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

 Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

 
 What we’re looking for
 You may be a strong fit if you:
 Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product .

 Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers .

 Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

 Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas .

 Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

 Are genuinely AI-forward : you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

 Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

 Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

 
 We’ll be especially excited if you
 Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

 Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs .

 Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

 Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

 
 Why REMATIQ?
 A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

 AI is the product and the way we work: You’ll help define what an AI-native product organization should actually look like, rather than simply adding AI tools to traditional processes.

Project Manager Business Solutions – SAP SD (w/m/d) 

 Berlin-Adlershof – Hybrid (max. 2 Tage Homeoffice/Woche), 30+3 Urlaubstage 

 Du willst nicht einfach Tickets bearbeiten, sondern international geschäftskritische IT-Projekte leiten, die SAP-SD-Landschaft einer globalen Pharma-Gruppe steuern und als Bindeglied zwischen Business und Technik echte Wirkung entfalten?

Hier geht es nicht um isolierte Customizing-Aufträge ohne Kontext. Hier geht es darum, die Einführung von SAP-Lösungen voranzutreiben, externe Integratoren zu steuern und globale Geschäftsprozesse harmonisieren – in einem 130-jährigen Unternehmen, dessen Berliner Hub häufig Pilotprojekte für 140+ Länder umsetzt.

 Unser Kunde 

Unser Kunde ist ein internationaler Pharmakonzern mit rund 400 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und über 17.000 weltweit. Das Kerngeschäft: Forschung & Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln sowie Shared Services (IT, Finanzen, Einkauf, Logistik, Engineering) für ein Schwesterunternehmen.

Das Umfeld ist stabil, teamorientiert und stark von Qualitätsbewusstsein geprägt. Keine ständigen Umstrukturierungen, sondern langfristige Perspektiven, strukturiertes Onboarding und eine ausgeprägte Fehler- und Wissensaustauschkultur. Das 45-köpfige Innovation Office ist jung, international und flach hierarchisch – und genau hier wird jetzt ein Project Manager Business Solutions – SAP SD gesucht, der IT-Projekte leitet und die SD-Domain verantwortet.

 Warum diese Rolle spannend ist 

 
 Du leitest internationale, wirkungsvolle IT-Projekte mit standardisierten Methoden – von der Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung

 Du treibst die Einführung der SAP-Lösung mit Schwerpunkt SD-Module voran – Steuerung von Systemintegratoren, Konfiguration, Wartung, Updates, Fehlerbehebung

 Du arbeitest als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT – Übersetzung geschäftlicher Anforderungen in hochwertige IT-Konzepte

 Du bekommst echten Gestaltungsspielraum statt Hierarchie-Bürokratie – flache Strukturen im Innovation Office, direkter Draht zum CIO

 Du unterstützt globale Prozessharmonisierung – Berlin als Pilot-Hub für konzernweite Initiativen

 Hands-on-Mentalität ist hier kein Buzzword auf der Karriereseite, sondern schlicht notwendig. Tragisch selten geworden.

 
 Aufgaben

 
 Leitung internationaler, wirkungsvoller IT-Projekte unter Anwendung standardisierter Methoden – erhebliche Wirkung, messbarer Impact

 Vorantreiben der Einführung der SAP-Lösung mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf den SD-Modulen – Steuerung von Systemintegratoren für Systemkonfiguration, Wartung, Updates und Fehlerbehebung

 Leitung des Bedarfsmanagementprozesses – Überwachung der Erfassung, Prüfung, Genehmigung und Umsetzung kosteneffizienter Lösungen

 Umsetzung geschäftlicher Anforderungen in hochwertige IT-Konzepte – Bindeglied zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen und technischen Teams

 Unterstützung von Initiativen zur Abstimmung globaler Geschäftsprozesse und -systeme durch strategische Unternehmenslösungen

 Aufbau funktions- und länderübergreifender Verbindungen – Förderung von Synergien zwischen verschiedenen Initiativen, Leitung von Projekten mit erheblichen Auswirkungen auf die Organisation

 Planung, Entwicklung, Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Anwendungen – Berücksichtigung neuer Technologien, Beratung der Kunden hinsichtlich geeigneter Technologie

 Zuständigkeit für alle IT-Belange der Sales & Distribution Bereiche – Maintenance und Customizing beauftragen, Projekte durchführen

 Auswahl, Beauftragung und Steuerung externer Dienstleister/Lieferanten für SAP SD-Lösungen – inklusive Aufwand- und Kostenabschätzung

 Stakeholder- und Change-Management während der Projektumsetzung – du führst Menschen mit, nicht nur Prozesse

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Nachweisbarer Erfolgstrackrecord als Project Manager oder SAP SD Consultant in komplexen Unternehmensstrukturen – mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren IT-Rolle

 Berufserfahrung im SAP-Bereich, insbesondere im SD-Modul – SAP S/4HANA-Erfahrung ist zentral, nicht verhandelbar

 SAP SD-Modul-Erfahrung (SAP S/4HANA) – aktuelle, hands-on funktionale Expertise inklusive Customizing-Verständnis

 Exzellente Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Stakeholdern – du navigierst durch komplexe Organisationen, nicht nur durch Tickets

 Business-level English (B2) und fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) – du kommunizierst sicher mit internationalen Kollegen und deutschen Stakeholdern

 Bereitschaft, komplexe und anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen mit Engagement zu meistern – Pharma-IT ist reguliert, nicht simpel

 Hohe Serviceorientierung und Commitment zu erstklassigen Dienstleistungen – du denkst in Patiente

jobs.title: Product Manager - Global Mobile
jobs.description:
Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. 

 

 By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier.

 

 Now, we’re scaling fast and building the next generation of products to accelerate the green energy transition. From making it effortless to switch to heat pumps, solar and EVs, to launching smart tariffs and creating renewable generation at scale, we’re solving some of the most complex challenges in energy with speed, creativity and customer obsession. We’re also enabling our global businesses to reach the full capability of what we’ve achieved in the UK, taking the learnings, products and experiences that customers love here and rolling them out worldwide.

 

 About the role

 

 Our mobile app is how millions of customers interact with Octopus every day. It's global first, lives across multiple countries, and is growing fast.We need a Product Manager who can own the product direction for key areas of the app, navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, and ship features that genuinely make customers' lives easier. 

 

 This is a role where you’ll be fully embedded with engineers and designers, shaping what we build and how we build it. You'll coordinate across country teams, balancing local needs with a global product vision. And you'll do it at startup pace, because even though we're big now, we still move like we're small.

 

 At Octopus Tech, you'll have real ownership, variety, and the chance to shape products that make a tangible difference in people's lives: lowering bills, enabling greener living, and delivering experiences customers genuinely love. You'll work side by side with teams across marketing, operations, and data, and see the impact of your work in the real world, fast. 

 What you’ll be doing… 
 

 
 Owning the product roadmap for your area of the mobile app, setting direction and making the calls on what gets built and when.

 
 Coordinating across Octopus's global markets. Our app serves customers in multiple countries, so you'll navigate competing priorities, align stakeholders, and find the right balance between local needs and global consistency.

 
 Working closely with engineers, designers, and data teams to define problems, shape solutions, and ship iteratively.

 
 Defining technical requirements for dependencies on other teams and clearly communicating priority to external teams.

 
 Developing, testing, and releasing features with scalability in mind.

 
 Scoping larger underlying system changes and making pragmatic decisions about sequencing.

 
 Monitoring existing customer journeys and new releases, using data to drive decisions and catch issues early.

 
 Collaborating with local Operations teams to test changes and debug issues with live journeys.

 
 Regular touchpoints with Marketing to identify trends, issues or improvements across funnels.

 
 Working across multiple teams (Marketing, Ops, Credit, Design, country leads) to build shared understanding and drive alignment.

 What you'll have... 
 

 
 3+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent working on mobile apps.

 
 Experience in startups or fast-moving scale-ups where you've had to figure things out without a rigid playbook.

 
 A track record of shipping mobile products that real people use and love.

 
 The ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, teams, and geographies without losing momentum.

 
 Real care for customers. You think about their experience constantly and push the team to get the details right.

 
 Strong communication with both front-end and back-end engineers.

 
 Experience taking problems (rather than strict guidelines) and developing strong solutions.

 
 The ability to recognise what needs to be done, and just as importantly, what doesn't need to be done right now.

 
 A talent for spinning many plates and context switching between competing demands without dropping quality.

 
 Confidence in making decisions quickly, even with incomplete information.

 
 Confidence tackling large-scale, ambiguous tasks and breaking them into something shippable.

 
 An empathetic approach to collaboration.

 
 Love for being the glue that holds cross-functional teams together.

 Nice to have... 

 
 Experience working on apps serving multiple markets or languages.

 
 Familiarity with energy, utilities, or other regulated industries.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Security Engineering (Security Posture and Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Senior Manager of the Security Posture Management (SPM) team within the Product Security Department, you lead the team that secures GitLab's own software factory: the estate we build and ship from. Your team drives comprehensive, governed rollouts of GitLab's security capabilities across every project, applying our own product the way our customers do, and builds proactive software supply chain security as a first-class capability within Product Security.

This is Customer Zero work with real reach. Where the team hits friction adopting our own features at scale, that signal goes straight to Product and Engineering as an early read on what customers will experience. Where it succeeds, it becomes the story of how GitLab secures its own software factory, told publicly and used by our go-to-market teams.

You will own the direction, delivery, and growth of this team. You set priorities toward the highest-leverage work, build the team out while it is still forming, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

What You’ll Do  

  • Lead comprehensive, governed rollouts of GitLab's own security capabilities across the estate, bringing every project into alignment with our Project Security Configuration Standard and keeping it there.
  • Set a security baseline that accelerates engineering rather than gating it, so teams inherit secure defaults and paved paths instead of negotiating requirements project by project.
  • Serve as Customer Zero for GitLab's security features: capture where adoption at scale is hard, and feed that evidence to Product and Engineering as a leading indicator of customer sentiment and a driver of roadmap decisions.
  • Establish proactive software supply chain security as a first-class capability in Product Security, including third party component governance, trusted dependency controls, and the requirements behind product-level SBOMs.
  • Reduce systemic risk across our own groups and namespaces, including lateral movement and token governance.
  • Own the operations of the Product Security Risk Register and the metrics and dashboards that give the department a single, data-driven view of our posture.
  • Partner with Compliance to produce evidence of our security control implementation for audits, certifications, and internal security maturity assessments, so the same work that hardens the estate also satisfies the auditors.
  • Represent this work externally, contributing thought leadership on how GitLab secures its own software factory that strengthens our go-to-market narrative and customer trust.
  • Lead, coach, and grow the team, and shape how it operates as it forms.

What You’ll Bring 

  • Experience managing a security or engineering team, including hiring, performance, and career development.
  • Technical fluency across security posture management, software supply chain security, and secure configuration of a large SaaS estate, enough to guide prioritization, coach the team, and get hands-on when necessary.
  • A track record of driving broad, governed rollouts of security capability across an engineering organization you do not own, and sustaining adoption after launch.
  • Experience translating security requirement

About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
 
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and shape the future of reporting and insights as the Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Insights.

Your mission: enable customers and internal teams to answer critical workforce, payroll, finance, and compliance questions with confidence through trusted, well-designed reporting and insights experiences.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Sales, Customer Success, Security, Legal, and Operations, you will bring the customer judgment, technical depth, and product craft needed to build reporting that is accurate, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI-assisted workflows and insights.

You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with cross-functional partners to ensure every reporting and insights capability succeeds commercially, technically, and operationally.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Set the reporting and insights strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for a multi-surface reporting system across in-app report building, dashboards, scheduled delivery, exports, APIs/connectors, embedded partner surfaces, and AI/agent experiences.
  • Deeply understand customer reporting needs: Build empathy for payroll, finance, HR, executive, manager, internal operator, and partner/builder personas — translating different workflows, trust thresholds, and AI readiness levels into clear product priorities.
  • Build trusted reporting foundations: Own payroll-grade reporting capabilities including standard reports, configurable report building, GL/journal exports, variance reporting, reconciliation, definitions, permissions, lineage, auditability, and observability.
  • Develop intelligent insights experiences: Identify where AI, anomaly detection, driver analysis, and proactive recommendations can help users understand what changed and what to do next — while keeping outputs explainable, source-backed, and compliant.
  • Deliver through strong cross-functional execution: Partner with Data, Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Sales, CX, Finance, Operations, and partners to turn customer needs into technically sound, scalable reporting solutions.
  • Measure and improve impact: Establish KPIs for adoption, engagement, trust, report accuracy, distribution usage, retention, expansion, and internal leverage; continuously use feedback and data to improve the product.

What you bring

  • Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on reporting, analytics, data platforms, workflow, or insights products.
  • Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand data schemas, query patterns, analytics code, and AI-assisted workflows hands-on.
  • Data Understanding & Fluency (Required): Strong end-to-end data literacy across models/schemas, lineage, and report generation. Comfortable with grain/joins/aggregations and common pitfalls (double-counting, currency/timezones, effective dating, late-arriving data).
    • Able to read/write SQL to validate results, investigate discrepancies, and ensure metrics are well-defined, reconciled, and trustworthy. Partner effectively with Data/Engineering to resolve definition and modeling issues.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II, Powered by TodayTix
jobs.description:

 TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix , New York Theatre Guide , London Theatre , Show-Score , Arthouse , Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema ––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. 

 

 Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. 

 

 In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI , the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. 

 

 L i f e a t T oda yTix G ro up 

 We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. 

 

 New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. 

 

 Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. 

 

 We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. 
 

 About the Role: 

 
 Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organisations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organisers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the PxT team — someone who thrives on data, moves fast, and is obsessed with identifying friction and building products that meaningfully improve how people discover, buy, and experience live events.

 You'll own product discovery and delivery for a key area of our platform, working directly with producers and event organisers to understand their needs, shape solutions, and bring them to life alongside world-class engineering and design teams.

 You instinctively reach for AI to think, prototype, validate ideas, and accelerate learning. You'll often start with ambiguity rather than requirements and enjoy identifying opportunities, forming hypotheses, and turning ideas into action.

 This role sits at the intersection of user experience and business strategy. It's ideal for someone who combines strong product instinct with platform thinking — someone who values speed, learning, and measurable outcomes over perfection. You'll also manage or mentor other PMs, contributing to how we grow product craft across the team.

 Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code

You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.

Location & work mode

Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

What you'll do

  • Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
  • Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
  • Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
  • Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves
  • Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap
  • Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it
  • Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships
  • Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you
  • Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other

What we're looking for

  • A track record of shipping things people actually use
  • Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience
  • Exceptional product and operational judgement
  • Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus
  • Shameless customer obsession
  • Extreme clarity in writing and thinking
  • Speed without sloppiness
  • Low ego and a builder's instinct

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company
  • Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg
  • Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table
  • A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process
  • 26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra days off for Christmas and New Year's Eve
  • Annual personal development budget for conferences, courses, books, or coaching
  • Regular team events, off-sites, and the kind of culture that makes you want to be in the office

jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. The Kotlin plugin for IntelliJ IDEA is where language meets experience — it's how hundreds of thousands of developers write, navigate, refactor, and understand Kotlin code every day. Being able to continuously improve it means understanding the language deeply, using the product daily, and deeply caring about Kotlin developers.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who will own the Kotlin-in-IDE experience end to end. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will experiment with Kotlin in IntelliJ based IDEs every day, maintain reference projects that double as regression canaries and demo showcases, build prototypes with AI coding agents, analyze users feedback and talk to users. You won't manage from slides — you'll manage from the editor.

In this role, you will:

  • Coordinate with Kotlin language team, Developer Advocates, framework partners, Marketing, and other JetBrains teams.
  • Create external visibility through what's-new posts, Kotlin User Groups meetup talks, and feature previews at events like KotlinConf, Spring I/O, Devoxx and others.

We're looking for someone who:

Du arbeitest eng mit cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen und gestaltest Lösungen, die echten Kundennutzen schaffen.

 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Produktmanagement, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit End-to-End-Verantwortung für Integrations-, API- oder Daten-Produkte .

 Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Shipping kundenseitiger Integrationen über mindestens einen vollen Lebenszyklus.

 Starke technische Fluency — du liest API-Dokumentationen flüssig, schreibst SQL, verstehst Datenmodellierung und kannst die Lösung eines Engineers fundiert challengen.

 Vertraut mit B2B-Enterprise-Integrationsmustern — inkl. Authentifizierung, Datensynchronisationsmodellen, Batch- vs. Event-getriebenen Flows.

 Regulatory Background — Erfahrung in oder mit regulierten B2B-Domains.
